text:
alex_dev: Heads-up team — opened a PR that changes how we encrypt and rotate audit logs. Can someone from sec/infra take a look? It's touching KMS grants + auditlog config + a short migration step. https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/platform/pulls/4821 :eyes:

sam_security: @alex_dev on it. I'll check the KMS policy changes and the key usage bits. Do you have a short risk summary?

alex_dev: TL;DR: new customer-facing logs will use a dedicated KMS key (kms-audit-prod), existing logs stay on current key for 30d then we rotate them into kms-audit-prod via a background job. Also adding a grant for logging-service to decrypt and write. Migration is incremental, no downtime expected. PR has details and a migration script: 

```bash
# dry-run for migration
./tools/migrate_audit_keys --dry-run --limit 1000
```

lee_infra: Can you paste the IAM diff here? I want to confirm there are no wildcard grants.

alex_dev: pasted below — trimmed for brevity:

```json
- "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"*"}]
+ "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01"}]
```

sam_security: Good — that narrows scope. A couple asks: (1) Add an audit log entry when the migration job re-encrypts a batch, (2) Add a KMS key policy note in the PR description explaining who can create grants, (3) confirm CMK rotation period in docs.

alex_dev: Will add those. I already added a logging hook to the migration job, but i'll put an explicit audit event. Updating PR now.

ci-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #4821 — unit tests, infra-plan, and e2e staging smoke.

ci-bot: infra-plan check: OK. unit tests: OK. staging-smoke: flaky tests detected in logging integration, re-run queued.

lee_infra: I'll take the staging smoke re-run and validate no perf regression. If staging looks good I can run a constrained canary in prod with 5% traffic for 4 hours.

beth_sre: Let's not merge during business hours. Recommend merge window in our 2am maintenance slot and monitor error budget for 3 hours post-merge. Also please add an explicit rollback step in the runbook.

alex_dev: Agree — planning to merge 02:00 UTC tomorrow to match the SRE window. I'll add rollback steps and the audit log note.

sam_security: One more nit: in the KMS policy snippet, we should restrict the logging-service principal to only the service role arn (not wildcard service). After that, :eyes: from me and i'll approve.

lee_infra: I checked staging perf — no regressions on write latency within noise. Can confirm canary plan. I'll approve once PR update lands.

alex_dev: Updates pushed: added audit events, explicit key policy paragraph, rollback steps, tightened principal to service role. Triggering CI again.

ci-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #4821 — unit tests, infra-plan, and e2e staging smoke.

ci-bot: unit tests: OK. infra-plan: OK. staging-smoke: OK.

sam_security: LGTM after addressing the one principal restriction — thanks for moving fast. :thumbsup:

lee_infra: Approving — will kick off a 5% canary in prod at 02:00 UTC and watch metrics.

beth_sre: Approved for merge in the 02:00 UTC window. I'll monitor error budget and paging thresholds for 3 hours post-deploy.

alex_dev: Thanks all — merging at 02:00 UTC and monitoring logs/alerts. I added the runbook link in the PR description. If anything pops, I'll roll back and post updates here. :rocket:
